name: codex-claude-desktop-bridge
description: Asynchronous two-way messaging between Codex and Claude Code conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Send messages between Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Find conversations and send text between Codex and Claude Code. Works with Codex and Claude in their desktop apps and terminals. Either side can start a conversation or reply. Windows uses native local transports; macOS reaches Codex through a configured SSH host.
defaultPrompt: Open the Claude conversation panel beside this Codex chat so I can search chats, read history, and send a message manually.
Find the Claude Code session I name and send it my message.
Check the bridge status and recent outgoing deliveries.
